title: JWST MIRI: How Mid-Infrared Spectra Fingerprint Exoplanet Atmospheres (2026)
description:
Most people think telescopes take pictures. They don't. They read chemical signatures. This short breaks down how the James Webb Space Telescope's MIRI instrument uses mid-infrared light to detect carbon dioxide and water vapor on distant worlds.

You will see exactly how spectral peaks form and why mid-infrared is the key to finding habitable conditions. No fluff, just the physics of detection.
